mapper.insert: INSERT INTO discount_policies (policy_name, discount_type, discount_value, condition_type, start_date, end_date, active_yn, description) VALUES (#{policyName}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{conditionType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{activeYn}, #{description})
mapper.update: UPDATE discount_policies SET policy_name = #{policyName}, discount_type = #{discountType}, discount_value = #{discountValue}, condition_type = #{conditionType}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, active_yn = #{activeYn}, description = #{description} WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}
